title: Figure 39. Titan Launch Summary (bar chart, 1959–1995)
description: Stacked bar chart of Number of Titan Missions per Launch Year from about 1959 to 1995, with black segments for "Normal Performance" and white segments for "Failure/Anomaly". Launches peak in the mid-1960s at roughly 28 per year and decline to under 10 per year after 1980. Text notes anomalous launches correspond to entries in Table 45. Captioned "Figure 39. Titan Launch Summary".
